_comment: S11 Workstream A (the strong-pipeline photo demo): = sitl3_vision.json but over the convoy_3lane world (3 cars in 3 DIVERGING straight lanes) with save_marker_frames ON. Each drone hovers (sentry_scan) over ONE lane, reads ONLY its car's unique ArUco id, and saves an annotated JPEG of it to runs_finals/<run>/marker_frames/<drone>/. Run via sim/run_vision.sh lanes3 (sets PX4_GZ_WORLD=convoy_3lane + LANES3_POSES + a straight convoy on ids 7/23/88 @ 0.2 m/s). DRONE<->CAR<->LANE: alpha (band 1.2, over car_7 @ ~(4.2,0)), bravo (band 1.7, over car_23 @ ~(-2,3.5)), charlie (band 2.2, over car_88 @ ~(-2,-3.5)). Spawns >=1.2 m from each car start and lanes >~5 m apart so the nadir footprints (r ~= 1.18*band) never overlap = clean 1-drone->1-car->1-id. Endpoints/ports identical to sitl3_vision.json: PX4 instance i -> udpin 1454<i>, mavsdk_server gRPC 5005<i+1>, onboard cam x500_mono_cam_640_<i> bridged to TCP gazebo_video_port 560<i>. Timeouts sized from the SIM-5 measured RTF (~0.86 at cam update_rate 5; clock is wall time.monotonic): command_timeout_s 90, mission_budget_s 500. camera_hfov_deg 99.69. detector none: ArUco (marker_backend) is the primary detector. VM-TUNE the LANES3_POSES + CONVOY_LINEAR so each car dwells under its drone during the scan.
